name: st-risk-for-uav
description: 无人机时空风险评估与任务分配系统 — Monorepo

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:web & pnpm run dev:node & pnpm run dev:py
scripts.dev:py: cd apps/server/python-fastapi-backend && uv run uvicorn src.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:node
scripts.start:py: cd apps/server/python-fastapi-backend && uv run uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:node
scripts.lint:py: cd apps/server/python-fastapi-backend && uv run ruff check src/
scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:py
scripts.test:py: cd apps/server/python-fastapi-backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v
scripts.db:py-migrate: cd apps/server/python-fastapi-backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:py-revision: cd apps/server/python-fastapi-backend && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.clean: pnpm run clean:web && pnpm run clean:node && pnpm run clean:py
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd apps/server/python-fastapi-backend && uv sync
